Lina (Support): FYI - Qorex onboarding blocked during initial ingest. Two issues: intermittent SSO 401s for some users and search returning empty results after ingest. Customer running final validation. Renewal ~62 days. Can CS escalate? INC-7019 :exclamation:
Hector (CSM): Acknowledged. Sandbox only or affecting prod? Need a short impact blurb for account health.
Lina (Support): Sandbox/preprod mirror. Logs: `auth: invalid_audience status=401` and embed pipeline: `indexer: dim_mismatch expected=768 got=512`. They used older embedding client.
Mei (CS Ops): I'll own reindex/migration. Quick workaround: run `embed-migrate --from=512 --to=768 --batch=500` or we can provide a one-click job. Backfill est 5-7h depending on dataset.
Hector (CSM): @Rafi can eng force a JWKS/IdP refresh for the tenant or enable a tenant toggle? We need a stopgap before the customer loses confidence.
Rafi (Eng): Triage shows IdP rotated keys and our JWKS cache missed it for that tenant. Ops command to force refresh: `curl -XPOST https://internal.api/tenants/qorex/actions/refresh_jwks -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>"`. Can run now. Also can enable tenant flag `accept_legacy_aud` for immediate relief. Hotfix ETA to improve JWKS handling ~3h.
Lina (Support): Ticket INC-7019 updated with sanitized logs and sample tokens. escalation-bot: status -> escalated to CS + eng.
Hector (CSM): Draft customer note: "Hi Omar - we're investigating SSO failures in your sandbox and a separate embedding schema mismatch. Immediate: we'll force a JWKS refresh and provide a reindex script. Auth mitigation ETA ~3h; reindex plan ETA 24h. Request 30m sync within 1 hour." OK to send?
Sofia (Renewals): Flag renewal tracker: risk = Medium-High until reindex completes. Please add a 1-liner for buyer outreach.
Mei (CS Ops): I'll prep the migration script and a short runbook. Will offer an overnight run window. Sharing artifact link in thread once ready.
Rafi (Eng): Running tenant JWKS refresh now for `qorex`. Will post status in ~10m. :rocket:
Hector (CSM): Internal comms plan (short):
- Immediate: force JWKS refresh + optional legacy-aud toggle  owner: Eng (Rafi)  ETA: 0-3h
- Short-term: patch JWKS caching behavior  owner: Eng infra  ETA: 3-6h
- Reindex: migrate embeddings + re-embed job  owner: CS Ops (Mei)  ETA: 5-8h (overnight option)
- Customer sync: 30m within 1h  owner: CSM (Hector)
Hector (CSM): I'll schedule the 30m sync for 10:30am PT and send the note. @Lina attach sanitized logs and @Mei post the migration link when ready.
Lina (Support): Attached sanitized logs and failing request IDs. :white_check_mark:
escalation-bot: INC-7019 comment added by Lina: "Escalated: CS + Eng. Suspect JWKS cache + embed client schema mismatch. Artifacts attached."
Sofia (Renewals): Added account health note, will monitor and update if backfill delayed.
Mei (CS Ops): Migration script nearly ready, will upload runbook in 15m.
Rafi (Eng): JWKS refresh done for tenant `qorex` - monitoring auth metrics. Report back if any 401s persist.
Hector (CSM): Thanks team. I'll own comms and weekly follow-ups until resolved. Ping me for regressions or if customer requests a temporary rollback option.
